text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Super Creek
as usual—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... haa~...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This new training is really great.
It puts less strain on my legs, too~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, as expected of you, Trainer♪

Lately, Super Creek's condition has been improving,
and she's been handling this training flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right, next up is a light dash on the dirt course~.

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
With such half-hearted training,
you'll never even make your debut.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you are...
The one who called out was the veteran trainer who had tried to scout Super Creek during the selection race.

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you had teamed up with me, you would have already
made your debut by now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My trainer has been doing a great job
with training that suits me, though...

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It seems you are overestimating this rookie trainer's abilities.
...In that case, let's have a mock race to prove their worth.

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If we race our respective Uma Musume, it will become clear
who is better at drawing out their talent.

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You'll accept, right?
Assuming you're confident that you're the one best suited for Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what should we do...

I may be a rookie, but I believe I have more desire to support her
than anyone else.

That's why I'm the one who can make her shine the brightest...
I'm the one best suited for her!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If a trainer's duty is to put their Uma Musume first,
then it's only natural to be confident that you are the best fit for them—

text_block_list.name: First-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if we win, you won't have any objections to me
taking over Super Creek, right?

Super Creek transferring away...!?
If those are the stakes, there's no way I can accept this match—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Of course, that sounds perfectly fine to me.

Even though a loss meant she might be transferred away,
she casually agreed to the match.

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I certainly didn't expect you to answer.
Does this mean you're expressing a desire to transfer to my team?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, no~, not at all, you see.
I don't have the slightest intention of losing~.

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever your reasons, the outcome remains the same—you'll be transferring over.
I look forward to our race.
With that, the veteran trainer walked away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now then, we'll have to do our very best with our training~.
choice_data_list: Why did you accept the match!?
Why did you agree to the match!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: After all, you're confident that I'm the one most suited for you, which is why you said you'd accept the challenge, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That I'm the one who belongs with you the most, Trainer...
I'm so happy you feel that way~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So, you don't need to look so anxious.
I will definitely live up to your expectations, Trainer.
She is trying to live up to my feelings.
Then I must show her that I'm worthy of that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So, you're tellin' me to help out with your training, then.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it was the Trainer's idea.
He said doing side-by-side training close to a real race would be best.
choice_data_list: I want to live up to her trust.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah, feels like he just wants to spoil you, though.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. I gotta teach that total moron of a Trainer who tried to poach you without even considering your feelings a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tama-chan. You're going to help me out~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? You're tryin' to pat my head, aren't ya!?
I ain't a kid, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, Tama-chan~.
And so, we continued our training in preparation for the race against the umamusume trained by the veteran trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer-san.
Tomorrow is finally the day of the race~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's okay, it's okay... rest easy♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan said before that I tend to coddle and spoil people as soon as I get the chance...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I just want to see everyone smile. The children at the daycare, and you, Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, wanting to coddle and spoil others is exactly what gives me the strength to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even if you're a rookie, I'll prove to everyone that you're a wonderful trainer♪
